punchline: The best connector in Silicon Valley did a five-minute favour for someone every day.
thirty_sec: Adam Grant tells of Adam Rifkin, named the best connected person in Silicon Valley. Rifkin was shy and modest. His one habit was the five-minute favour: a short help for everyone, known or unknown, with no return expected. Over the years thousands piled up, and around him formed a wide network of people who felt grateful to him.
